sentences.text: Xiyunykus pengi, meaning 'western claw', is the only known species in this genus.
It belongs to the superfamily Alvarezsauroidea, a group of specialized theropods.
Xiyunykus displays intermediate features between early alvarezsaur ancestors and later alvarezsaurids, bridging a 70-million-year gap in limb and tooth evolution.
This animal lived in Asia during the Early Cretaceous, specifically between 136 and 120 million years ago in the Aptian stage.
Its fossils were discovered in the Tugulu Group rock formations.
Some researchers suggest the fossil record for this taxon may actually span from 137.05 to 132.6 million years ago.
